summary: The Iceberg community is actively discussing various integration efforts, including support for Flink SQL procedures and the management of Flink version support following the upcoming Iceberg release. Additionally, preparations are underway for the release of PyIceberg 0.12.0 and Apache Iceberg C++ 0.3.0, alongside discussions on enhancing the Iceberg REST Catalog and addressing GitHub Actions usage.
highlights: Integration of Flink SQL procedures support for Iceberg
Management of Flink version support after Iceberg 1.11.0
Proposal to add OpenTelemetry MetricsReporter to iceberg-core
